leaked_early.details: Bloomberg reported on March 28, 2012, that Amylin had rejected a $22.00 offer from BMS, approximately 3 months before the official announcement.

notes: The deal followed a competitive auction triggered by an unsolicited $22 bid from BMS, with the final $31 price representing a 101% premium to the undisturbed price after a leak in March 2012 caused a significant stock surge.
